notes.title: Happy Golden Week! Sakura DLC is now available
notes.content:
[h2]It's time to celebrate![/h2]

A special period for Sclash is coming right now as the Golden Week has started in Japan!

Not only, but this day marks a very special day for our team: Sclash is available now on consoles! You can sclash with (or against...) your friends on all consoles on top of PC!

To celebrate all these events, we have released a "Sakura" DLC which features a new cool weapon and mask. 

This DLC is PC exclusive so grab it right now!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/000333cc194916fa7d3586da4d4f3d5e96f48283.jpg[/img]

[i]Stay tuned because next stop might be free content... [/i]
Thanks again for all your support throughout the latest months. The journey has been incredible so far, and this is not over!

Have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/8e3dbcfc38c4393de292974dfe15fe64f7edf770.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Next update
notes.content:
Hey guys,
We thought it's been a while we hadn't posted anything on here.
So just letting you know, the next update is almost complete, there's just one nasty bug in there and then we'll release it.

[h3]Briefly, it will include among other things :[/h3]
- REBINDS, FUCKING REBINDS (This is where there's one last bug)
- A bit of balancing
- More accessibility options
- Some achievements & seasonal events were not triggering correctly so we fixed those
- Random stage on online lobby creation
- Made weather effects togglable and less frequent
- Sound when a player joins a room
- Disabled cheats online for those who might have tried using them
- Fixed stage selection settings
- Removed the annoying scarf online
- General polish & bug fixes

I promise we're doing what we can to fix this last thing. (Basically rebinds only work if you restart the game, so I guess in the worst-case scenario we can just release it like that...)

Once that's done GOG and itch.io will have the online mode arriving soon
Thanks for your support, stay tuned

notes.title: 1.1.44 balancing update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, before bug fixes for the online mode and an upcoming tournament we wanted to update a bit of the game's balancing after the community's feedback and our feelings about the characters.

IZANAGI
- Increased attack range a bit
- Increased parry recovery speed
- Made stomp anim faster
- Increased a bit stomp range
- Sped up a bit Perfect Parry anim

SUSANOO
- Increased a bit invulnerability duration on dashes. i-frames also start earlier now
- Sped up a bit kick anim startup
- Sped up a bit attack animations

JINMU
- Removed i-frames on his neutral attack
- Reduced a bit light attack range

MASKED RONIN
- Increased a bit pommel strike range

OTHER STUFF
- Changed parry stamina recovery to be 3 bars instead of 2
- Changed stamina break to be 1 bar instead of 2

Hopefully, these will make the game feel more balanced and all options worth it. Let us know your thoughts when playing this new version, thanks !

notes.title: Online mode is live TODAY !
notes.content:
[h1]Rollback netcode online mode is available now![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/e8100234052dac7ac6ff07b04dbd4fccaab78c17.png[/img]

After a first launch during the EVO 2023 in Las Vegas, the PC version finally gets the online mode with a rollback netcode that you all awaited! In online mode, you can create and join private rooms as well as look for fighters in the matchmaking system. 

[h2]Get the "Pixels" DLC for free![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/45fb8b841e3b32722ea068a65658f61a6e8a62f2.jpg[/img]
To celebrate the PC online launch, you can get new “Pixel” skins for free for a limited time directly through Steam.
Add the DLC to your account and you have now unlocked them!

[h2]Japanese is in![/h2]
Japanese speakers, the Japanese subtitles have been implemented in the game... 日本へようこそ!

[h2][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/d5dcc10849daad6a256efa384ff623564fe0a776.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37554654/888595c2ab7067d3bc413818106961bca14e31ff.png[/img][/url] Event [/h2]

We’re taking part in the War Child UK Armistice Sale!  
Starting today (7 pm CET/10 am PT) and until November 15th, we’ll donate a portion of every sale of Sclash. to War Child UK. Make sure to grab your discounted copy, gift one to a friend, or let them know about the sale. 
This year’s Armistice Sale is celebrating peaceful play and highlighting the importance of protecting, educating, and standing up for the rights of children living in war zones. War Child work in the hardest-to-reach places to support those who are hardest hit, to protect, educate, and stand up for the rights of children, when they need them most. 

Find out more about War Child here - [url=https://www.warchild.org.uk/our-work ]https://www.warchild.org.uk/our-work [/url]


[h3]Waiting for the console version?[/h3]
Even if most of you are already playing Sclash on PC, the console versions are ready and in the hands of the consolidators for approval. We don't have a definitive date to announce, but they should arrive in the next few weeks! :)

[h3]Next step : Steam Awards... [/h3]
We would love that you consider Sclash in your choices for the next Steam Awards by the end of November... Vote for us in the "Outstanding Vistual Style" when the Steam Awards 2023 comes out!

notes.title: 1.1.1 - "Save file erased" bug fixed ! And other stuff
notes.content:
[h2]SAVE FILE CORRUPTED BUG :[/h2]
[b]- Fixed! [/b]The game was not recognizing Chapter 5 save files because of some last-minute changes. The good news is that the save file is not deleted, unless you overwrote it by starting a new game you should be able to continue your playthrough normally.

[h2]OTHER STUFF :[/h2]
- Enforced 16:9 aspect ratio for wide screens
- Set Akiko to not be here in Zen mode in Chapter 5
- Adjusted firewall distance for Ryuujin checkpoint in Chapter 4
- Changed the speed of the Firewall visuals
- Unlocked story achievements that did not trigger for some people, now if you completed the story mode you should have them.
- Updated credits to put some names that were missing from them
- Fixed active frames of Masked Ronin
- Added text indicator below the modes' names in the story menu to tell the player they will overwrite their current save file if they have one.

[b]Thanks, everyone, for reporting bugs![/b]

notes.title: Christmas & slice update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are releasing a new update for the demo of Sclash!

- You can now enjoy a Christmas ambience in the game as long as January goes! (Sorry for the delay on this one)
- You can slice in half some parts of the environments!
- 2 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS IN THE DEMO
- Overall better looking and better optimized
- COSMETICS!

We hope you'll have fun with it!
And don't forget to join us on social media and share the game if you like it ;)
